story: A breakaway group of six escaped early. Sivakov, Vader, and Schoofs joined in the hills. The escapees were caught at the base of the final climb. Multiple attacks from GC contenders followed, with Gall and Onley proving strongest. Gall dropped Onley 4.6 km from the finish and soloed to victory, taking the overall lead.
